PF2EActionForge.Title: PF2E Action Forge
PF2EActionForge.Subtitle: Fast access to character actions
PF2EActionForge.SourceActor.Label: Acting character
PF2EActionForge.SourceActor.Hint: Follow the controlled token automatically, or pin a specific actor from the list. While an action is in progress, the acting character is frozen.
PF2EActionForge.SourceActor.NoneHint: Control one of your creature tokens or choose an owned character, companion, or familiar.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Heading: Actions
PF2EActionForge.Actions.CatalogHint: Choose an action, assign its targets, and keep frequently used actions close at hand as favorites.
Recall information with an appropriate knowledge or Lore skill; the roll and outcome remain hidden according to PF2e secret-check handling.

PF2EActionForge.Actions.Grapple.Name: Grapple

PF2EActionForge.Actions.Trip.Name: Trip
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Trip.Description: Athletics against Reflex DC to knock a creature prone.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Climb.Name: Climb
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Climb.Descriptio: Athletics against an environmental DC to move along an incline or vertical surface.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Lie.Name: Lie
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Lie.Description: Deception against one target’s Perception DC; the roll and outcome are hidden from players.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Demoralize.Name: Demoralize
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Demoralize.Descr: Intimidation against Will DC to frighten a creature.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.TreatWounds.Name: Treat Wounds
PF2EActionForge.Actions.TreatWounds.Desc: Treat a living creature’s wounds with Medicine; healing, Wounded removal, and the 60-minute immunity are managed from the result.
